full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media digital illustration shows the close side profile of an older man facing right, his sharply modeled blue-gray face emerging from a dense collage of geometric and natural imagery. Thick black round glasses cross his eyes and extend toward his ear, anchoring the recognizable face amid the abstraction. The forehead, nose, mouth, and chin have engraved-looking wrinkles and stippled shadows, with cool cyan highlights on the skin. His back of head dissolves into a complicated field of triangular meshes, translucent polygons, tiny green leaves, sunburst circles, and small architectural fragments. Several golden hexagonal and star-like solids float through this field. A pale wireframe dome curves over the upper right of his skull against a warm ivory background. The collage grows denser toward the left edge, where blue, violet, yellow, and green shards overlap like a visual map of ideas. Across the lower left, the imagery opens into a luminous turquoise sea with tiny white sailboats and distant low islets. A diagonal pale-blue band cuts upward beneath his jaw, separating the sea from the dark layered collage. The composition is tightly cropped around the head, but open ivory space at the right keeps the profile legible. Light appears to come from the upper right, whitening the bridge of the nose and forehead while deeper blue shadows emphasize the eyes and neck. Fine linework, print-like texture, and translucent overlays coexist with detailed facial modeling. The whole image feels intellectually expansive yet visually unified by the clear profile silhouette and recurring geometric lines.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介数字插画呈现一位年长男子面向右侧的近景侧脸，立体感强的蓝灰面孔从密集的几何与自然意象拼贴中浮现。粗黑圆眼镜横过双眼并伸向耳朵，在抽象部分中固定住可辨认的面容。额头、鼻子、嘴和下巴带有仿雕版的皱纹与点状阴影，皮肤上有冷青色高光。他的后脑溶入复杂领域：三角网格、透明多边形、细小绿叶、放射圆盘和微型建筑碎片交错。数个金色六角形与星状实体悬浮其中。浅色线框穹顶从头顶右上弯过，背后是温暖象牙色底。拼贴朝左边缘变得更密，蓝、紫、黄、绿碎片像思想地图一样叠合。左下方，图像向明亮的青绿海洋敞开，水上有小白帆船和远处低矮小岛。一条浅蓝斜带从下巴下方上切，分开海面与深暗多层拼贴。构图紧贴头部裁切，但右侧敞开的象牙色留白让侧脸清楚可读。光似乎来自右上，照亮鼻梁和额头，更深蓝的阴影强调眼和颈。精细线条、印刷般肌理与透明覆层同细致面部塑造并存。整幅图既有思想扩张感，又被清楚的侧影轮廓和反复出现的几何线条统合。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media digital collage style interlaces finely modeled blue-gray forms with translucent geometric overlays and miniature organic details. Thin wireframe arcs, triangular meshes, faceted polygons, and radiating circles multiply across the image, while delicate linework keeps even dense passages readable. Cyan and turquoise provide cool luminosity; violet and deep navy establish shadow; small ochre-gold accents add sparkle against a warm ivory ground. Some areas are sharply engraved and stippled, others resemble printed paper fragments or watercolor washes. Layers transition from highly clustered detail to clear open space, allowing a dominant silhouette to remain legible. Diagonal bands and overlapping transparent planes create motion across a compact square crop. Light gathers on raised contours and glints through selected facets, while dark blue pockets provide depth. The overall effect is intricate, speculative, and tactile, combining recognizable volume with an expansive network of visual associations.
style_prompt_zh: 这种混合媒介数字拼贴风格将细致塑造的蓝灰形体与透明几何覆层及微型有机细节交织。细线框弧线、三角网格、切面多边形和放射圆盘在画面中不断增殖，精巧线条却让密集区域仍可读。青色与松石绿提供冷调亮度；紫色和深海蓝建立阴影；少量赭金色在暖象牙底上闪烁。有些区域锐利如雕版并带点刻，有些像印刷纸碎片或水彩薄涂。层次从高度集中的细节过渡到清澈留白，让主要轮廓保持明晰。斜向带状结构与透明平面的重叠在紧凑方形裁切中制造运动。光聚集于凸起轮廓并从选定切面闪过，深蓝色暗处提供纵深。整体效果复杂、富想象力且有触感，把可辨认的体积与广阔的视觉联想网络结合。
theme_en: An older thinker in glasses interwoven with geometric worlds and a turquoise sea
theme_zh: 戴眼镜的年长思想家与几何世界、青绿海洋交织
name: Buckminster Fuller
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
